descriptionChirho: Financial increase or profit gained through lending, often paired with neshekh ('interest/usury') in legal prohibitions. All 7 occurrences refer to the same economic concept. S145797 covers standard conjunctive forms (eng 'and increase', spa 'e interés/y ganancia', arb 'وَزِيَادَةً', kor '그리고 이익을/그리고 과다한 이익을', swa 'na faida', hin 'और लाभ/और मुनाफ़ा'). S145798 covers forms appearing in textual-critical brackets or with added prepositions (eng 'and usury', spa '[y con interés]', arb '[وفائدة]', kor '그리고 이익으로', swa '[na faida kubwa]', hin '[और वृद्धि]'). Both clusters describe the same financial gain/increase concept; the split reflects editorial bracket notation and prepositional variation, not a distinct sense.
